page.overview:
Who is Astre-De-Kay?

Vice President Astre-De-Kay was an eligible candidate for the position of President of the Tiss'sharl League around 0 ABY. However, the ambitious Geor-Dan-Thi had De-Kay assassinated, wishing to eliminate all contenders for the Presidency.
